title: TenantBrandConfig
description: Schema for a per-tenant brand profile stored in TenantConfig.branding_config. All fields are optional for fallback support; required fields are enforced at provisioning time by validate-tenant-brand-pack.sh.

tenant_id.description: URL-safe tenant slug, must match TenantConfig.slug (e.g. 'skillourfuture').

display_name.description: Human-readable tenant name shown in page titles and footers (e.g. 'Skill Our Future Academy').

logos.description: Brand logo assets. All values must be absolute HTTPS URLs.

primary.description: Full-colour primary logo (min 200px wide, PNG or SVG). Shown in LMS header.

white.description: White/reversed version of primary logo. Used on dark backgrounds.

footer.description: Logo variant rendered inside the MFE footer slot (often smaller or white).

palette.description: Tenant palette inputs used by sync-tenant-branding.sh to generate tenant token overrides and by runtime branding to expose PRIMARY_COLOR/SECONDARY_COLOR style MFE config keys. They are not a guaranteed live plugin-injected --mereka-color-* runtime surface today. All values must be 6-digit hex.

primary.description: Primary brand colour (buttons, links, active states). Example: '#2d898b'.

secondary.description: Secondary brand colour (accents, hover states). Example: '#295cad'.

text.description: Default body text colour. Must achieve WCAG AA contrast against 'background'.

typography.description: Font metadata reserved for future runtime font loading. Current runtime keeps the shared compiled font stack unless an explicit loader is added.

font_family.description: CSS font-family stack for body text. Example: '"Nunito", sans-serif'.

heading_font.description: CSS font-family stack for h1–h4. Defaults to font_family if omitted.

font_source_url.description: URL for a future runtime font loader (Google Fonts stylesheet URL or self-hosted HTTPS path). Not auto-injected today.

footer.description: Footer plugin-slot configuration for the MFE footer component.

variant.description: Named footer variant. Determines which MerekaFooter branch is rendered.

copyright_holder.description: Legal entity name shown in copyright line. Example: 'Mereka (M) Sdn. Bhd.'.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp support number in E.164 format. Example: '+60123456789'.

legal_links.description: Footer legal navigation links (Terms, Privacy, Cookies).

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL to the legal document.

social_links.description: Social media icon links shown in footer.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL to the tenant's social profile.

legal_doc_urls.description: Canonical URLs for legal documents served under this tenant's domain.

terms.description: Terms of Service / Terms and Conditions URL.

cookies.description: Cookie Policy URL. Omit if covered by the Privacy Policy.

fallback_tenant_id.description: Slug of another tenant whose brand profile to inherit when a field is missing. Default runtime fallback is 'mereka' (the platform default).

_meta.description: Audit metadata — populated by the provisioning script, not manually edited.

schema_version.description: Schema version this profile was validated against.

approved_by.description: GitHub username of the reviewer who approved this brand profile.

source_pr.description: GitHub pull-request URL where the brand profile was reviewed.
